items.name: airframe
items.title: Airframe
items.description: The Airframe design system as the tool repos vendor it: the --af- tokens (Night and Day), the af- component classes and the icon sprite. CSS only; works in any project. Load airframe.css, then airframe-components.css.

items.name: airframe-tailwind
items.title: Airframe for Tailwind CSS v4
items.description: The --af- tokens plus a Tailwind v4 @theme that maps every utility onto them (bg-canvas, text-fg-muted, font-mono, text-label, rounded-card). Removes Tailwind's default color, font, radius and shadow scales so an Airframe project has no bg-blue-500. Import both files after `@import "tailwindcss"`.

items.name: airframe-tokens
items.title: Airframe design tokens (DTCG)
items.description: Every Airframe token in the W3C Design Tokens format (DTCG 2025.10), one complete file per theme, for Figma variables, Style Dictionary, Terrazzo and other token tools. Also the resolved-per-theme JSON the suite's scripts use.

items.name: skill
items.title: Airframe skill for coding agents
items.description: A SKILL.md (Agent Skills standard) that keeps Claude Code and Codex on Airframe when they build UI: tokens only, the af- classes, the six statuses, the dark-cockpit rule, and where each component's contract lives. Installs for both agents.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: DM Mono capitals on a 2px radius: primary (signal yellow, one per view), secondary, ghost and danger, at 34 or 28 px. Installs the component contract (markup, classes, do and don't); the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: The six statuses, each color + shape + word: running (grey circle), queued (ring), needs approval (orange diamond), failed (red triangle), denied (red placard), off (small dot). Running and queued stay grey: the dark-cockpit rule. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Tonal cards: raised on canvas, 4px radius, 16px padding, no border and no shadow, with top, body and foot parts and a lit state for when a person is needed. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: fleet-bay
items.title: Fleet bays
items.description: The fleet as bays: one box per sandbox grouped by environment, with tail number, status, the work, owner, harness, a labeled stage track, lease left and the one action it needs. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: react
items.title: Airframe React wrappers
items.description: Thin React components over the af- classes: Button, Status, Card and Icon. They compose class names only, so they cannot drift from the CSS; the CSS comes with the airframe item. A prototype: the suite's consoles are vanilla JS today.
